steps.why: A big expressive display role carries the brand.

steps.rule: A recessed fill, a step below content.
steps.pick: neutral.100, a step below content (1.13:1 on surface.default), so table headers and wells read as recessed.
steps.darkPick: neutral.100, a step below content (1.21:1 on surface.default), so table headers and wells read as recessed.

steps.question: How much is on one screen?

steps.why: Tables are rare and short, so there is no need to fit many rows. Comfortable rows keep the brand's airy rhythm.
Tables are rare and never compared column by column, so mono digits add nothing. The brand font keeps the voice.

steps.rule: Quiet edges and dividers. Decorative, so it has no contrast minimum.
steps.pick: neutral.200: a quiet line that stays visible on every surface it meets (lowest 1.26:1, on surface.canvas). It decorates, so it holds no contrast minimum.
steps.darkPick: neutral.200: a quiet line that stays visible on every surface it meets (lowest 1.69:1, on surface.default). It decorates, so it holds no contrast minimum.

steps.pick: neutral.900: the strongest text step, 18.0:1 on surface.default, above the 4.5:1 floor.
steps.darkPick: neutral.900: the strongest text step, 17.12:1 on surface.default, above the 4.5:1 floor.

steps.pick: dm-sans for data text: Bricolage Grotesque for display and headings, DM Sans for text: loud where the brand speaks, easy where people read.

steps.question: Which states get their own visible value?

steps.why: Fast feedback, on the brand's spring. An instant change drops the brand's motion.

steps.rule: The fill of the item the pointer or the keyboard is on, or whose submenu is open. A state shows on the item's background, one step from the surface it sits on: darker in light, lighter in dark.
steps.pick: neutral.100, two steps darker than the surfaces it sits on (neutral.0), so the item under the pointer or the keyboard reads as a band without lifting off the page. It skips neutral.50, the page canvas, so a menu item never matches the page behind it.
steps.darkPick: neutral.100, one step lighter than the surfaces it sits on (neutral.50), so the item under the pointer or the keyboard reads as a band on the menu and on cards.

steps.question: What is the main task?
steps.why: People browse and explore the story.

steps.question: How many signals carry each meaning?

steps.rule: The fill of a selected or current item, or a toggle that is on.
steps.pick: pink.light.100: a tint of the brand, 1.15:1 from content, always beside its edge (border.selected), so selection is never color alone.
steps.darkPick: pink.dark.100: a tint of the brand, 1.22:1 from content, always beside its edge (border.selected), so selection is never color alone.

steps.rule: The edge that marks a selected item, beside its fill, so selection is never color alone.
steps.pick: pink.light.600: the edge beside a selected fill, so selection is never color alone, 4.84:1 on surface.default, above the 3:1 floor.
steps.darkPick: pink.dark.600: the edge beside a selected fill, so selection is never color alone, 8.88:1 on surface.default, above the 3:1 floor.
